claims.text: AA launched AA-AgentPerf-Local Sep 29 (day-only): open-source local inference tool replaying real agent trajectories (8 tasks, 168 turns, ~56K growing context, identical token work; tool execution skipped by default); code on GitHub.
claims.context: Artificial Analysis article Sep 29, full body read.

claims.text: Hardware Spark 128GB / RTX 5090 32GB / Ryzen Halo 128GB / M5 Pro 64GB; models Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Ling 3.0 Flash 124B/5B-active at 4-bit; 14 speculative configs (MTP/DFlash/DSpark).

Active-params trend with exceptions; RTX 5090 fastest where fits (>3.5x); Spark 1.4-1.7x Halo on 3/4 despite 7% bandwidth gap (compute/CUDA maturity); MacBook within 2-9% Halo on 2 models; prefill 22-41% despite 73-93% KV hits; speculative +30-120% decode.
Tests inference serving, NOT autonomous task correctness or model intelligence.
